stories.title: “That’s 10 full time nurses”: North Wales reacts to £262,500 Betsi Cadwaladr chief executive salary
stories.summary: People across North Wales have been having their say after it was revealed top bosses at Betsi Cadwaladr University Health Board earn more than Prime Minister Andy Burnham. stories.title: Seabed lease signed for carbon storage project running from Flintshire coast
stories.summary: A gas terminal at Talacre is at the centre of the UK’s first carbon storage project to reuse existing infrastructure, after a seabed lease was signed. stories.title: Bidston to Wrexham trains cancelled after Shotton bridge hit
stories.summary: Trains between Wrexham Central and Bidston were cancelled in both directions this afternoon after a lorry hit a railway bridge at Shotton station. stories.title: Deestriders member completes 64-mile Beacons Way ultra
stories.summary: Deestriders RC runner Paul Lewtey won the Rhes y Cae 10k on Saturday in 40:06. Christine Cammillare was second lady at the Flintshire race in 48:19, with Guy Christall finishing in 56:21. stories.title: North Wales ketamine campaign launched as hospital admissions climb
stories.summary: Emergency department admissions linked to ketamine in North Wales rose from 241 in 2023 to 412 in 2025, an increase of 71% in two years.
